headline: Turkey offers up to 5-year residency permits for $150K-$200K investments
summary: Turkey announced new immigration incentives offering three- to five-year residence permits to foreign nationals who invest between $150,000 and $200,000 in the country, aiming to attract inbound capital.
why: Turkey frequently adjusts residency and citizenship-by-investment rules to stabilize foreign currency reserves and bolster the domestic real estate and commercial sectors.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Lower investment thresholds for foreign residency aim to draw incremental foreign capital into the Turkish economy.
